title: LIST: December 2026 special non-working days in PH provinces, cities, towns
summary: Here are the December 2026 special non-working days in various localities, as proclaimed by the President

blocks.text: (L-R) Photo from M’lang Tourism Facebook page; LGU Virac Tourism Promotion Facebook page; One Cainta Facebook page
Here are the December 2026 special non-working days in various localities, as proclaimed by the President
MANILA, Philippines – This is a compilation of special non-working days in various localities in the Philippines for December 2026, as proclaimed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
